text: dsh-plugin-claude-import 是面向 DSH Web 的 Claude Code 会话导入插件。它在 DSH 主机注册会话列表和会话导入工具，并在 Web 对话标题栏加入“Claude 导入”入口。用户可以按会话 ID 查找本地 Claude Code 历史记录，将其整理为 seed 上下文或 Markdown 续接文档，也可在原项目目录创建 DSH 工作区和新会话并投递上下文。适合希望把 Claude Code 工作进度带入 DSH 继续处理的开发者。主机需要能够读取 ~/.claude/projects 中的会话文件。

dsh-plugin-claude-import brings Claude Code sessions into DSH Web. Tools list local sessions and convert one into seed context or a Markdown continuation document. A Web header panel can create and open a DSH session in the project directory. The host reads ~/.claude/projects.
想把 Claude Code 的旧会话带到 DSH 里接着做。
DSH 能不能列出我电脑上的 Claude Code 历史记录？
把一个 Claude 会话整理成可以复制到新对话里的上下文。
我想把之前的编程对话导出成 Markdown 续接文档。
根据 Claude 会话新建一个 DSH 项目会话，并把原来的上下文发进去。
I want to continue a Claude Code session in DSH with its prior context.
Can I turn an old coding conversation into a Markdown handoff document?
dsh-plugin-claude-import 的功能「查找 Claude 会话」：列出本地 JSONL 会话及标题和统计。调用 claude_session_list，可指定会话根目录。
dsh-plugin-claude-import 的功能「生成续接上下文」：按会话 ID 导入记录，整理摘要、最近任务和文件足迹。调用 claude_session_import 可选 seed 或 Markdown 格式。
dsh-plugin-claude-import 的功能「Web 快速导入」：在对话标题栏打开 Claude 导入面板，输入会话 ID 或留空采用最近会话，并发送导入指令；随后等待新会话出现并打开。
How can I bring my previous Claude Code work into a new DSH session?

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · dsh-plugin-claude-import：Import [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) sessions (`~/.claude/projects/*.jsonl`) into [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) as **continuable context** — an auto-summary chain, the last task, the file footprint, and the tail state — rather than an event replay.

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · dsh-plugin-claude-import：The plugin is the DSH-native port of [claude-code-to-dsh](https://github.com/changhang155/claude-code-to-dsh) (a zero-dependency Python CLI that produces the same seed / markdown documents).

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · Features：- **Agent tools** (host half):
  - `claude_session_list` — list sessions under `~/.claude/projects` (id / project / title / mtime / size / message stats).
  - `claude_session_import` — import one session as a **seed** context block (paste-ready for a new session) or a full **markdown** continuation document; with `createSession=true` it creates a new DSH session in the Claude session's project directory and delivers the context as its first message.
- **Web GUI** (client half): a "Claude 导入" action in the conversation header — enter a session id (empty = most recent) and the plugin creates a new DSH session, opens it, and seeds the import instruction.

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · Requirements：- `dsh` ≥ `0.1.0-rc.6` (npm: `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`), Node.js ≥ 18.
- A local Claude Code installation with sessions under `~/.claude/projects` (the plugin reads them from the dsh host process).

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · One command (bundle flow, recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-claude-import
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin` links it, appends it to the profile's bundles, and applies its patch layer (which inserts the plugin row). Restart `dsh web` and verify:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep claude
```

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · Manual (into an existing profile)：```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add dsh-plugin-claude-import
```

Then register the row in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: claude-import
      name: 'dsh-plugin-claude-import'
```

Restart `dsh web`.

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · From GitHub：No build step is required (plain JS), so a git install works without a `prepare` script:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:changhang155/dsh-plugin-claude-import#<sha>
```

If pnpm refuses to run scripts, allow the build in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (`allowBuilds: dsh-plugin-claude-import: true`) and re-run the add.

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · Peer dependencies：The plugin uses `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy`, and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` as peers, resolved from the dsh installation. When installing into a fresh profile, ensure those are present (the web profile already bundles them; a bare profile may need `pnpm add` of the peers or symlinks to the dsh install's `node_modules/@deepseek-ai`).

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · Usage：**From the agent:** ask for the list, then import:

```
请列出 Claude Code 的历史会话。
把会话 <id> 导入为 seed,并在其项目目录下新建一个 DSH 会话。
```

The tool `claude_session_import` accepts:

| parameter | meaning |
|---|---|
| `sessionId` | 8-char prefix, full id, or a full `.jsonl` path |
| `format` | `seed` (default) or `markdown` |
| `createSession` | create a new DSH session in the Claude project dir and deliver the context as its first message |

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · Usage：**From the Web GUI:** click **Claude 导入** in the conversation header, optionally type a session id, and press 导入. A new session is created and opened; its agent reports the title, touched files, and open threads.

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · Compatibility：DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview — **compatibility-breaking changes are expected**. This plugin targets the `0.1.0-rc.6` npm line (peer ranges use `^0.1.0-rc.6`). If a later rc breaks the client contract (`window.__ModuleLoader__` / slot injection), update the plugin or pin your dsh version.

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · Compatibility：The import is heuristic: session titles come from Claude's `ai-title` / `summary` rows; the "touched files" list only covers Write/Edit (and Read) tool calls; local-command-mode sessions (mostly command injection) are detected and annotated rather than misread as conversation.

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · Development：```sh
git clone https://github.com/changhang155/dsh-plugin-claude-import
cd dsh-plugin-claude-import
npm test            # node --test tests/ (no dependencies)
node --check lib/index.js lib/client.js lib/parse.js

Layout:

dsh-plugin-claude-import README · Development：- `lib/index.js` — host half: registers the two agent tools (`defineTool` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`).
- `lib/client.js` — client half: the Web GUI dock (loaded via the client runner).
- `lib/parse.js` — pure-Node Claude Code JSONL parser (no dependencies).
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch layer that activates the plugin.
